This Writ Petition (Civil) Having Come Up For Admission On
20.02.2019, The Court On The Same Day Delivered The Following:
 WP(C).No. 5163 of 2019 2
 Judgment

The petitioner has approached this Court seeking the following relief :-
''Issue a writ of mandamus or other appropriate writ or order or direction directing the respondents to consider Exhibit P5 request filed by the petitioner before the 3rd respondent within a reasonable time filed by this Hon'ble Court.''
2. Heard the learned counsel for the petitioner and the learned Government Pleader.

3. It is submitted by the learned counsel for the petitioner that pursuant to proceedings initiated against the petitioner under the Provisions of the Food Safety and Standards Act and the Regulations issued thereunder, the premises where the coconut oil had been stocked by the petitioner had been sealed.
Action has also been taken against the petitioner by cancellation of the licence and prosecution in respect of the offences as against him.

It is also submitted that the petitioner has preferred Ext.P5 representation before the third respondent, seeking removal of the seized stock of coconut oil from the premises, so that the petitioner will be enabled to surrender vacant possession of the building to the land lord.
It is submitted that the petitioner is forced to pay rent for the building through he is not conducting the business any more.
4. I am of the opinion that Ext.P5 representation preferred by the petitioner is liable to be considered by the third respondent in accordance with law.

There will be a direction to the 3rd respondent to take up, consider and pass appropriate orders on Ext.P5 representation within a period of three weeks from the date of receipt of a copy of this judgment.
The writ petition is ordered accordingly.

SD/-
 ANU SIVARAMAN
ACM / 20.02.2019 JUDGE
